data.title: 不知火舞 · 道场红绸的花嫁扇舞
data.description: 不知火舞穿着红白花嫁礼装站在道场中央，折扇与捧花分别握在两手；她先以熟练步法旋身让红绸扬起，再收扇面对镜头，笑容既有大和抚子的端庄也有胜负场上的自信。
data.action: 道场中央以扇舞扬起红绸，收扇面对镜头，端庄与武者自信并存
data.lighting: red-gold evening light across wooden boards
data.mood: 大和抚子与武者的花嫁扇舞
data.promptProse: Standing centered upon the wide wooden boards of the Shiranui dojo at dusk in her radiant white-and-red satin bridal kimono, flowing veil, and floral pins, Mai finishes a graceful ceremonial turn as her long crimson sash settles around her. Holding a closed folding fan cleanly in one hand and a bridal flower bouquet in the other, she faces forward with poised martial dignity and a warm, confident smile. Rich red-gold sunset light stretches long across the polished dojo floor.
data.animaCaption: Standing center floor in the sunset-lit dojo in her white-and-red satin bridal kimono and veil, Mai holds a closed folding fan in one hand and a flower bouquet in the other with a poised, confident smile. Red-gold evening light washes across the wooden boards as her long crimson sash settles.
